simple.meaning: חוּג (chûwg) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to describe a circle.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 26:10. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חוּג (H2328) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חוּג (chûwg) / H2328 is traced through Job 26:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2328. chug [ חוּג ] verb draw round, make a circle (Aramaic circumivit ; noun , חוּגְתָּא , circle, vault of heavens ) — Qal Perfect מים עלפֿני חָג חֹק Job 26:10 (compare Prov 8:27 ), hath drawn as a circle a bound, etc., of the horizon-line.
